vacates office earlier or removed from office by the Council,
hold office for a period of one year until the election of new
members for the Council at the annual general meeting of
the  Institute  and  be  eligible  to  re-appointed  for  not  more
(2)  Where  a  member  of  the  Council  vacates  office  by
death,  resignation  or  any  other  cause,  another  member  of
the Institute shall be elected in place of such member having
regard to the provisions of subsection (2) of section 11.
